zh: 早稻田大学（Waseda University，简称早稻田、早大）1882年由日本前首相大隈重信创立，校本部位于日本东京都新宿区，是日本享负盛名的研究型大学，也是亚洲最为国际化的大学之一，是一所私立综合性研究型大学。在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列日本私立大学第1、全球第196位。学校以"学问独立"和"培养贡献社会的人才"为理念，校友遍布政界、商界、学术界及文艺界，国际化程度高，与全球众多高校有合作项目，留学生比例约占20%。
en: Waseda University, founded in 1882 by Okuma Shigenobu, former Prime Minister of Japan, is located in Shinjuku District, Tokyo, Japan. It is a prestigious research university, one of the most international universities in Asia, and a private comprehensive research institution. Ranked 1st among private universities in Japan and 196th globally in the QS World University Rankings 2026, the university adheres to the philosophy of "academic independence" and "cultivating talent contributing to society". Its alumni are spread across politics, business, academia, and the arts, with a high degree of internationalization and cooperation programs with numerous universities worldwide, and approximately 20% international students.
